ajio.note: Session/cookie-based scraping (3rd type). Camoufox harvests a WAF-approved session (cookies+UA) into the scraper_sessions table; replayed via the curl fast-path until it expires, then auto-regenerated. See scraper/session-manager.ts.

tatacliq.note: Uses internal product API with session cookie.

ikea.note: Price from inline prefixedProductId/price pattern. Title from <title> tag.

decathlon.note: Price and title from JSON-LD @type:Product offers.

lenskart.note: Price and title from JSON-LD @type:Product offers.

meesho.note: Akamai WAF blocks desktop UA. Uses axios with Android mobile user-agent. Price and title from JSON-LD post-render.

nykaafashion.note: Blocks desktop UA. Uses axios with iPhone mobile user-agent. Price and title from JSON-LD.

croma.note: Akamai WAF blocks desktop UA. Uses axios with Android mobile user-agent. JSON-LD has literal newlines; price extracted via regex.

jiomart.note: Price is 0 in SSR. Uses Playwright browser with domcontentloaded wait. Price from data-price attribute or JSON-LD post-render.

blinkit.note: Uses Playwright with domcontentloaded (networkidle never resolves). Price and title from JSON-LD post-render.
